# Vendored Lexbor (HTML5 parser + DOM, CSS parser, selectors) as a single-TU static
# library. lexbor.h/lexbor.c are generated by regenerate.sh from the pinned upstream
# commit, see README.md. Consumers `#include <lexbor.h>` (declarations only).
#
# Builds natively (GCC/Clang/MinGW) and under Emscripten: the posix port only needs
# libc, no threads.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(lexbor C)

add_library(lexbor STATIC lexbor.c lexbor.h)
target_include_directories(lexbor PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(lexbor PUBLIC LEXBOR_STATIC)
set_target_properties(lexbor PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Third-party code: silence its warnings instead of fixing them locally.
target_compile_options(lexbor PRIVATE
    $<$<C_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang,AppleClang>:-w>
    $<$<C_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/w>)

# MinGW's <sys/stat.h> has no symlink/socket file types; the posix port's
# lexbor_fs_file_type() only needs them as distinct switch labels.
if (WIN32)
    target_compile_definitions(lexbor PRIVATE S_IFLNK=0120000 S_IFSOCK=0140000)
endif ()
